scope: Pure synthetic fixture evidence only; no migration, Go/No-Go, authority, I/O, mutation, registration or activation.
api: compare_harbour_migration_snapshots(source,target,post)->HarbourMigrationComparison. Clone three exact H1R-05A snapshots before validation; each clone must pass H1R-05B project_harbour_knowledge_metadata and share schema/owner. Compare only knowledge_id_digest and record_digest.
output: HarbourMigrationComparisonError(code='invalid_comparison'); frozen slots/redacted HarbourMigrationDelta(label in {'source_to_target','target_to_post'}, missing_knowledge_ids,extra_knowledge_ids,changed_knowledge_ids); frozen slots/redacted HarbourMigrationComparison(schema_id='odysseus.harbour.snapshot_comparison.v1',owner_ref_digest,source_snapshot_digest,target_snapshot_digest,post_snapshot_digest,source_to_target,target_to_post). rules: missing is left-only; extra is right-only; changed is shared id with different record digest
exact built-in types, no subclasses/bools/aliases; retain no caller references
enforce inherited 10000-head bound and bounded context-free invalid_comparison errors
do not alter or reference legacy MigrationProof, GO/status/evidence operations, database/filesystem/network or Native adapter construction
